protocol.scope: all 305 unknown-language papers in the frozen 43-variant reference set
protocol.method: deterministic: Unicode script detection + weighted function/domain/distinctive vocabulary and orthographic markers; English is the competing hypothesis, and a non-English label needs score >= min_non_en_score with a margin >= min_non_en_margin over English
protocol.threshold_selection: grid search over 60 configurations on the odd-variant calibration half only (macro-F1 of en vs non-English); held-out half reported below
protocol.reference_set_edits: none on disk; backfilled labels live in this artifact only (in-memory copy)

provider_label_noise.note: Provider 'language' labels contradicted by the title script or by the journal name; these are excluded from the adjudicated accuracy below and are evidence that the provider metadata, not the classifier, is wrong.
